name: Susie Wiles
current_role: Political adviser to Donald Trump; White House chief of staff from January 2025 until she resigned on November 6, 2026
summary: Susie Wiles is a Florida Republican strategist who ran Rick Scott's 2010 campaign for governor, led Trump's Florida operation in 2016, rescued Ron DeSantis's 2018 campaign before falling out with him, and co-managed Trump's 2024 campaign. She served 21 months as White House chief of staff, the first woman in the job and Trump's longest-serving chief of staff, before resigning after the 2026 midterm losses; Trump said she would move to his political operation.
